title: AnnoCaseLaw: Legal Annotation Benchmark of Civil Negligence
abstract: arXiv:2503.00128v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Language models offer a way to scale costly, labour-intensive expert annotation, but their ability to reproduce expert judgements remains uncertain. This is particularly challenging in law, where annotators must distinguish the reasoning supporting judicial decisions from other legally relevant discussion. We present AnnoCaseLaw as a densely annotated benchmark comprising $471$ U.S. civil-negligence court opinions with more than $12,000$ expert highlights across five annotation categories. We evaluate proprietary frontier, open-weight, legal-specialised, and decision models on their ability to reproduce these annotations. Models perform better on Facts and Outcome than on Application of Law to Facts, Procedural History, and Relevant Precedents. On Application of Law to Facts, proprietary frontier models achieve the strongest balance of reasoning coverage and precision, while the open-weight model Gemma 4 achieves comparable Macro-F1

translated_title: AnnoCaseLaw：民事过失法律标注基准
translated_abstract: 语言模型为扩展昂贵且劳动密集的专家标注提供了一种途径，但它们复现专家判断的能力仍不确定。这在法律领域尤其具有挑战性，因为标注者必须将支持司法判决的推理与其他法律相关讨论区分开来。我们提出了AnnoCaseLaw，这是一个密集标注的基准，包含471份美国民事过失法院意见书，涵盖五个标注类别的超过12,000个专家高亮标注。我们评估了专有前沿模型、开源权重模型、法律专业化模型和决策模型复现这些标注的能力。模型在“事实”和“结果”类别上的表现优于“法律对事实的适用”、“程序历史”和“相关判例”类别。在“法律对事实的适用”上，专有前沿模型实现了推理覆盖率和精确度的最佳平衡，而开源权重模型Gemma 4则达到了相当的Macro-F1分数。
tldr: 提出了AnnoCaseLaw基准——一个包含471份美国民事过失法院意见书和超过12,000个专家标注的密集标注数据集，用于评估语言模型复现法律专家标注的能力，发现模型在“事实”和“结果”类别上表现较好，而在“法律对事实的适用”等需要复杂法律推理的类别上仍存在挑战。
